input.title: Apple Hospitality REIT Announces August 2018 Distribution
input.body:
[View all news](https://ir.applehospitalityreit.com/news/default.aspx)

# Apple Hospitality REIT Announces August 2018 Distribution

RICHMOND, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Apple Hospitality REIT, Inc. (NYSE: APLE) (the “Company” or “Apple Hospitality”) today announced that its Board of Directors declared a regular monthly cash distribution of $0.10 per common share for the month of August 2018. The distribution is payable on August 15, 2018, to shareholders of record as of August 2, 2018.

Based on the Company’s common stock closing price of $18.20 on July 19, 2018, the annualized distribution of $1.20 per common share represents an annual yield of approximately 6.6 percent.

**About Apple Hospitality REIT, Inc.**

Apple Hospitality REIT, Inc. (NYSE: APLE) is a publicly traded real
      estate investment trust (REIT) that owns one of the largest and most
      diverse portfolios of upscale, select-service hotels in the United
      States. Apple Hospitality’s portfolio consists of 241 hotels with more
      than 30,700 guest rooms located in 88 markets throughout 34 states.
      Franchised with industry-leading brands, the Company’s portfolio
      comprises 115 Marriott-branded hotels and 126 Hilton-branded hotels. For
      more information, please visit [www.applehospitalityreit.com](http://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.applehospitalityreit.com&esheet=51840306&newsitemid=20180720005159&lan=en-US&anchor=www.applehospitalityreit.com&index=1&md5=ddd78340697adbfefa32ac53aa5e57d1).
